@graph.name: Airfield Inspection and Hazard Identification
@graph.description: Daily inspection and hazard-response procedure supporting safe airport operations.
@graph.abstract: This procedure identifies and corrects hazards affecting runways, taxiways, aprons, lighting, signs, safety areas, transient aircraft, and hangar rows.
@graph.creativeWorkStatus: Active procedure; approval and effective dates not provided in source

audience.audienceType: Airport personnel responsible for daily airfield inspections, hazard response, NOTAMs, and follow-up

@graph.yield: Airfield hazards are identified, addressed or communicated, and tracked through corrective action

itemListElement.name: Inspect airfield operating areas
itemListElement.text: Conduct a daily inspection of runways, taxiways, aprons, lighting systems, signs, and safety areas.
itemListElement.marin:completionCriteria: All listed operating areas and systems have been inspected.

itemListElement.name: Check for hazards and operational issues
itemListElement.text: Inspect for Foreign Object Debris (FOD), wildlife activity, pavement damage, standing water during winter, obstructions, lighting issues, transient aircraft requiring tags, and conditions in hangar rows.

itemListElement.name: Address hazards immediately when possible
itemListElement.text: Correct or control identified hazards immediately when the condition can be safely addressed.

itemListElement.name: Issue required NOTAMs
itemListElement.text: Issue NOTAMs for conditions that may affect aircraft operations.
itemListElement.marin:completionCriteria: Affected aircraft operators can receive timely notice of the condition.

itemListElement.name: Notify Airport Management
itemListElement.text: Notify Airport Management of significant safety concerns.

itemListElement.name: Track corrective action to completion
itemListElement.text: Follow up on identified hazards until corrective action is completed.
itemListElement.marin:completionCriteria: The corrective action is complete and the hazard no longer affects safe operation.

marin:responsibilityAssignment.description: Conducts daily inspections, identifies hazards, addresses conditions when possible, issues or initiates required notifications, and follows up.
Receives significant safety notifications and supports corrective action.

marin:retentionRequirement.retentionRule: The source requires inspection and follow-up but does not state a retention period.
